resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Former Fire Lookout Sites register gives 2,880 ft (878 m) and firelookout.com gives 2880 ft; Willhite lists the elevation as unknown because the exact spot inside Section 23 has not been found. The story reports the register figure and Willhite's uncertainty.

sources.title: Where was the Blue Canyon Lookout?

notes_for_editor: Brief record checked: 2012 FFLOS registration and gone status hold up; the brief did not record the 1941 build, which is added. One inference was removed from the story: the hiking-distance note does not show what the ground is like today. No design, height, staffing or access data in any source, so none recorded. Willhite's page is the only source with location detail and its date is not shown; it reports the Kresek inventory second-hand, and the Washington Lookouts page adds only the township and range. The register's coordinates give a point the sources do not tie to the lookout, so the story does not place the tower on a spot. WebSearch budget for this turn was exhausted by other agents, so no further sources were added.
